2024-11-05|WI|question-eligibility-to-vo.t: State of Wisconsin Eligibility to Vote Referendum
2024-11-05|WI|question-eligibility-to-vo.nt: Question 1, "Eligibility to vote" (2023 Enrolled Joint Resolution 71): Shall section 1 of article III of the constitution, which deals with suffrage, be amended to provide that only a United States citizen age 18 or older who resides in an election district may vote in an election for national, state, or local office or at a statewide or local referendum? The Chair determined on November 29, 2024 that it was approved by a majority of the electors voting on the question.
